Di hui numbers list mein kya koi do numbers hain jinka absolute difference threshold se strictly kam hai? True ya False return karo.
paren_string mein balanced parentheses ke alag groups hain. Spaces ignore karo, har outermost group ko alag string banao aur order mein list return karo. Groups ek doosre ke andar nested nahi hain.
Positive floating-point number ka fractional part return karo: number mein se uska integer part hata do.
Bank balance zero se shuru hota hai. operations mein deposits positive aur withdrawals negative hain. Agar kisi bhi step par balance zero se neeche jaye to True, warna False return karo.
numbers ka mean nikalo, phir har number aur mean ke absolute difference ka average return karo. Yahi mean absolute deviation hai.
numbers ke har do consecutive elements ke beech delimeter insert karo. Khali list ke liye khali list return karo.
Space-separated balanced parentheses groups mein har group ki maximum nesting depth nikalo. Usi order mein depths ki list return karo.
strings list se sirf woh strings return karo jinmein substring maujood hai. Original order rakho.
Integers ki list ka sum aur product tuple mein return karo. Khali list ke liye sum 0 aur product 1 hoga.
Har position tak dekhe gaye numbers ka maximum nikalo. In running maximum values ki list return karo.
Di hui string se shuru hone wala sabse chhota palindrome banao. Sirf end mein characters jodo; original prefix ko mat badlo.
Same-length binary strings a aur b ka bitwise XOR karo aur binary string return karo.
strings mein sabse lambi string return karo. Tie ho to pehli wali lo. Khali list ho to None return karo.
Integers a aur b ka greatest common divisor return karo.
string ke saare non-empty prefixes chhote se bade order mein return karo. Khali string ke liye khali list.
0 se n tak ke integers, n included, ek string mein single spaces se separate karke return karo.
string mein kitne distinct characters hain? Uppercase aur lowercase ko same maano.
Space-separated music notes ko beats mein badlo: o ka 4, o| ka 2 aur .| ka 1 beat. Beats ki list return karo.
string mein substring kitni baar aata hai, count karo. Overlapping occurrences bhi count karna.
Input mein zero se nine tak ke English number words spaces se separated hain. Numeric value ke ascending order mein sort karke space-separated string return karo.
Kam se kam do numbers ki list mein sabse nazdeek pair dhundo. Pair ko (smaller, larger) tuple mein return karo.
Kam se kam do numbers, jinka minimum aur maximum alag hain, ko linearly rescale karo: minimum 0 aur maximum 1 ho. Original order rakho.
Python values ki list mein se sirf integers filter karo. Python isinstance(value, int) ke hisaab se check karo; original order rakho.
Di hui string ki length return karo.
n se strictly chhota sabse bada positive divisor return karo. n ek integer hai aur n > 1 hai.
Positive integer n ke prime factors ascending order mein return karo. Repeated factors ko unki multiplicity ke saath rakho.
numbers mein jo value ek se zyada baar aati hai, uski saari occurrences hata do. Bache hue elements ka original order rakho.
string ke lowercase letters uppercase aur uppercase letters lowercase mein badlo. Baaki characters same rakho.
strings list ke saare elements ko bina separator ke jodkar ek string return karo.
strings mein se sirf woh strings return karo jo prefix se shuru hoti hain. Original order rakho.
List mein se sirf strictly positive numbers return karo. Zero include mat karo; original order rakho.
Agar integer n prime hai to True, warna False return karo. 1 prime nahi hai.

xs polynomial ke coefficients hain, constant term se shuru. Aisa ek real x dhundo jahan polynomial zero ho. Coefficients ki sankhya even hai aur highest coefficient nonzero hai. Multiple roots hon to koi ek return karo.
List ke zero-based indices 0, 3, 6, ... par values ko aapas mein ascending sort karo. Baaki indices ki values mat badlo.
List ke unique elements ko ascending order mein return karo.
Non-empty list ka maximum element return karo.
0 se n-1 tak un integers mein digit 7 ki total occurrences count karo jo 11 ya 13 se divisible hain. Jo dono se divisible ho use ek hi baar count karo.
List ke even zero-based indices 0, 2, 4, ... ki values ko aapas mein ascending sort karo. Odd indices ki values same rakho.
encode_cyclic har 3-character group ko ek position left rotate karta hai; aakhri chhota group same rehta hai. Encoded string ko decode karke original string return karo.
Fibonacci sequence mein jo numbers prime bhi hain, unmein n-th number return karo. Counting 1 se hai: 2, 3, 5, 13, 89, ...
Integer list mein kya teen alag positions ke elements ka sum zero hai? True ya False return karo. Equal values alag positions par allowed hain.

Seedhi infinite road par n cars left se right aur n cars right se left, same speed par chal rahi hain. Dono groups door se ek doosre ki taraf start karte hain. Takraane ke baad bhi cars chalti rehti hain. Opposite-direction pairs ki total collisions return karo.
List ke har element mein 1 add karke nayi list return karo.
Integer list mein kya do alag positions ke elements ka sum zero hai? True ya False return karo.
Nonnegative integer x ko base mein convert karke string return karo. Base 2 se 9 ke beech hai.
Triangle ka base a aur height h diya hai. Uska area return karo.
Fib4 sequence: f(0)=0, f(1)=0, f(2)=2, f(3)=0. n>=4 ke liye pichhle chaar terms ka sum lo. Recursion ke bina efficiently n-th term return karo.
Non-empty numeric list ka median return karo. Even length par beech ke do sorted elements ka average lo.
Kya text palindrome hai, yaani seedha aur ulta same? Case aur characters ko exactly compare karo. Khali string palindrome hai.
2 ki power n modulo p return karo. Bade n ke liye bhi sahi numeric result chahiye.
